mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) as income, COUNT(*) as count FROM sys_order WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND order_status = 1 -- 只统计已完成/已核销的 AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()

SELECT s.name, COUNT(o.id) as count FROM sys_order o LEFT JOIN sys_service_schedule sc ON o.schedule_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN sys_service s ON sc.service_id = s.id WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.order_status = 1 AND o.order_type = 1 -- 只统计服务预约 GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM sys_order WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND order_status = 1
